title: Bangsaen21 Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Bangsaen21 review: 13,000+ runners on Bang Saen beach on 21 December 2025, the world's first World Athletics Platinum Label half marathon, good conditions.
dek: Bangsaen21 became the world's first half marathon with a World Athletics Platinum Label, and more than 13,000 runners took part on 21 December 2025. Here is what it was like.
verdict: Bangsaen21 is a top-rated half marathon in Thailand. The 2025 edition, on 21 December, drew more than 13,000 runners to Bang Saen beach in Chonburi, and it was the world's first half marathon to hold a World Athletics Platinum Label [1]. Kenyan and Ethiopian elites dominated the podium, Thailand's Nattawut Innum won a seventh straight national title, and conditions were good enough for hundreds of runners to set personal bests, according to Khaosod English [1]. If you want a fast, top-level half marathon by the sea, this is it.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: More than 13,000 runners took part on Bang Saen beach on 21 December 2025 [1]. It was the world's first half marathon with a World Athletics Platinum Label [1].
The route runs 21 km along the coast [1]. It is organised by the same team as Bangsaen42, the marathon-only race held at Bang Saen in November.

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Kenyan and Ethiopian elite athletes dominated the podium, and Nattawut Innum won the Thai national title for the seventh year in a row [1]. Berlin Marathon's race director also ran the course [1].
Khaosod English reported perfect conditions, with hundreds of runners setting personal bests [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want the highest-rated half marathon in the region on a coastal course with a big field. It is a genuine target for a personal best.
Enter early, and book accommodation in Bang Saen or Chonburi ahead of race weekend.
This review is compiled from a news outlet's summary of the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Bangsaen21 and Bangsaen42?
